collect_model_attributes: collect specified attributes from all named modules in a PyTorch model and return them as a nested dictionary
apply_model_attributes: apply a dictionary of attribute values to the corresponding submodules of a PyTorch model
copy_model_attributes: copy specified attributes from a source PyTorch model to a target model and return the copied attributes
review_collect_model_attributes: review the collect_model_attributes function to understand how it iterates over named modules and extracts attributes
test_copy_model_attributes: test the copy_model_attributes function by copying attributes between two PyTorch models with matching submodule structure
